title: Jubilant French Lentils Tagine
description: Earthy, pillowy lentils simmered with basil and Mediterranean spices, perfect for a post-workout meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a tagine or heavy‑bottomed pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic, sauté until the onion becomes translucent.
Stir in the diced carrots and cook for another 3 minutes.
Pour in the canned tomatoes and vegetable broth, then add the dried lentils and cumin.
Bring the mixture to a gentle boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Add the chopped kale during the last 5 minutes of cooking to keep it tender yet vibrant.
Stir in the fresh basil leaves and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Check that the lentils are tender and have absorbed most of the liquid; if needed, add a splash more broth.
Remove the pot from heat and let the tagine rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, optionally with a side of crusty gluten‑free bread or a green salad.
